details:
i would like to see a button added to the game that can turn off cross platform play between the quest and pc players 

this will do 2 things 

one is separate the adults that are on pc from all of the kids on quest and hopefully bring back more of the adult community on this game that it desperately needs 

two is separate the people on quest from the pc users that uses clients that can get around the easy anti cheat that crashes them or causes them annoyance in the game in general 

i think a good way for this to be implemented would be when this button is toggled on all of the worlds that was pc and quest just becomes pc only or quest only and show up in the world search as such and it would take an effect when they leave the world so that way it wont break games that are going on in the current world and client users wont be able to get around this using the client still 

this way people on both platforms can still find enjoyment in the game and can be toggled on or off so the friends on different platforms can still play together when wanted
title: a button to toggle cross platform play
